message: The other night, we had an unexpected blackout that sent my heart racing for a moment. I remembered I had charged my power bank earlier that day, and it felt like I struck gold when I plugged in my phone to keep it alive. With a little flashlight in hand, we made the best of it—playing card games and sharing stories until the lights came back on. Sometimes, it’s those small wins that turn a potential panic into a cozy family night. How do you keep the good vibes going during a blackout?
